note: Day 3. Woke at 7:00 AM and skipped meditation. Breakfast from 7:35–8:00 AM: 2 eggs, unsweetened almond milk with chia seeds (no protein powder), and black coffee. Food was SCD-compliant, but today deviated from the morning protocol by skipping meditation and eating before 8 AM. Almond milk/chia portions and macros are rough estimates based on the prior breakfast. Lunch 12:00–12:45 PM at Cactus in Kirkland: Sonoran Spa Chicken with no cotija (grilled chicken breast, portobello, sautéed spinach, vegetable escabeche), following the SCD lunch-guide recommendation. Logged as compliant assuming any sweetened sauce was left off; macros are rough. Hunger at 2:40 PM: 5/10 (moderate); noted he needs water. At 3:35 PM, had an OWYN Pro Elite chocolate plant protein shake (12 fl oz, dairy-free, zero sugar), logged as a protein drink/snack. This fits his protein-powder habit, though canonical Ferriss guidance flags drinking calories as a watch-out; macros are rough. At 5:15 PM, reported no hunger (0–1/10): the 3:35 PM OWYN shake was holding up well after 1h40m+ and had killed the 2:40 PM hunger-5, linking the two checks for the satiety pattern. At 6:45 PM while driving to the Tim meetup, hunger was 6/10 and climbing, with an energy dip described as a sugar crash, some yawning, and thoughts of food; dinner was imminent. The 3:35 PM OWYN shake had held about 3h10m. Dinner 8:15–8:45 PM at Qdoba: chicken bowl with no rice, double beans, single chicken, no cheese, no sour cream, and guacamole. Logged SCD-compliant because avocado is allowed; estimated ~670 calories and ~48g protein, with all dinner macros marked rough. Ingredients: almondmilk (water, almonds), vitamin/mineral blend, sea salt, and gellan gum; SCD-compliant. Published breakfast totals remain unchanged and future estimates should use this label basis.
